TAP is being developed as part of the Automated Maintenance Management System (AMMS) program within the Configuration, Logistics, and Maintenance Resource Solutions (CLMRS) Group of Programs.
TAP includes an iOS App for used on FAA provided iPhone that simplifies data entry of logs with a focus on electronic Technical Performance Reports (eTPR) entries of required measurements needed for preventative maintenance (PM). TAP Mobile also automatically generates coordination logs, handles, approvals, and provides notifications of coordination events. 
TAP Connected is used on a PC to both create maintenance logs and allow users to view, filter, and customize logging data displays.

description:
This is a SaaS / PaaS instance of Box Digital Workspace Suite ii x.x in use by the organization listed in the solution name.

The Box Digital Workplace Series - Powering a digital workplace with Box and Office 365.  A digital workspace is an integrated technology framework designed to deliver and manage app, data, and desktop delivery. It allows employees to access their apps and data real-time—on any device, from any location, regardless of whether the information is stored through cloud services or in the data center.  With Cloud Content Management from Box, you build a digital workplace that drives unparalleled productivity, uniting all your content, people and applications on a single platform. By enabling teams to access the content they need from anywhere, securely work in the apps they know and love, and collaborate seamlessly across the extended enterprise.  When your teams collaborate and share documents in a central workspace, everyone stays productive. Box lets you comment and assign tasks directly within files, quickly share content with external teams, and create seamless, automated workflows with Box Relay. Plus, Box Feed uses the power of machine learning to surface the most relevant content based on the people and files you interact with most, enabling you to stay on top of all your work.  Share content with team members, both in and outside of your organization, across any device. With Box Drive, you can stream all your files directly from the cloud to your desktop, or use the Box web app to work in a browser. And for teams on the go, the Box mobile app lets you access content from any mobile device while keeping everything secure.   - Digital Workspace Suite II includes:  •  Box Enterprise •  Box Platform  •  Box Governance  •  Box Shield  •  Box Relay

description:

The Box Platform is a separate line of business, which offers APIs for customers creating their own applications.   Embed Box into any app, and empower your teams to work with anyone on a single, secure content platform. Whether you're onboarding a new supplier with SAP, finalizing a sales contract with Salesforce, or sharing financial data with a business partner, Box Platform streamlines how teams share, access, and collaborate on content across your business apps.  Box APIs enable you to connect to other systems and centralize content, metadata, and policies in the Content Cloud. Plus, you can run scripts to automate how content is migrated to the cloud, folders are managed, users are provisioned, and policies are applied. With Box Platform, you reduce cost and improve security across the board.  Building content apps can be hard. Box Platform makes it easy. Our developer tools, first-party SDKs, and integrated developer docs let you quickly build and deploy content apps in days, not weeks. Thanks to APIs, Box developers can focus on building great apps while Box takes care of the rest.

plannedactivitiesdescription_0:
AFS100 has a need to electronically sign documents using our internal tracking system. We need the ability to use "envelopes" within DocuSign to create and send these documents. Current DocuSign FedRamp account has limited permissions. I need an Account Administrator License to fully use the application within our new document tracking system, allowing other users within AFS100 to send "envelopes".

The Aircraft Evaluation Division (AFS-100 or AED) consists of approximately 150 inspectors and support staff located across the United States. As a geographically dispersed team, we operate without a centralized office and conduct our work in close coordination with aircraft manufacturers, other AFS divisions, and the general public. A core part of our responsibilities involves reviewing and formally approving or accepting technical documents—often submitted by non-FAA personnel—such as FAA letterhead correspondence, memoranda, and other regulatory materials.
Currently, our internal tracking system (ATS/CITRIX) is scheduled for decommissioning in December 2025 due to broader IT mandates. In preparation, we are developing a new system using the Microsoft Power Apps platform. To support this transition and maintain operational continuity, DocuSign Government is a critical tool. It provides secure, compliant, and legally binding electronic signature capabilities—ensuring we can continue to process and validate official documentation efficiently and in accordance with FAA and federal standards.

name: AFN AIT Microsoft Defender for EndPoint (MDE) x.x SaaS
fullname_0: AFN AIT Microsoft Defender for EndPoint (MDE) x.x SaaS
description:
This is a SaaS / PaaS instance of Microsoft Defender for EndPoint (MDE) x.x in use by the organization listed in the solution name.
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint is an enterprise endpoint security platform that helps defend against advanced persistent threats. Defender for Endpoint includes certain manual response actions that can be taken on a device that is detected as potentially compromised or has suspicious content. Customers can also run response actions on files that are detected as threats. 

Protection
MDE uses AI-powered protection to block malware and malicious activity. It offers real-time antivirus protection and can disrupt ransomware on any platform. 

Visibility
MDE provides visibility into devices and network activities. It helps you understand your cyberattack surface and adversaries. 

Response
MDE offers endpoint detection and response (EDR) and managed hunting. It can automatically disrupt sophisticated cyberthreats. 

Management
MDE is part of the Microsoft Defender portal, which provides a unified experience for managing incidents and alerts. 

Defender for Endpoint uses the following combination of technology built into Windows 10 and Microsoft's robust cloud service:

Endpoint behavioral sensors: Embedded in Windows 10, these sensors collect and process behavioral signals from the operating system and send this sensor data to your private, isolated, cloud instance of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

Cloud security analytics: Leveraging big-data, device learning, and unique Microsoft optics across the Windows ecosystem, enterprise cloud products (such as Office 365), and online assets, behavioral signals are translated into insights, detections, and recommended responses to advanced threats.

Threat intelligence: Generated by Microsoft hunters, security teams, and augmented by threat intelligence provided by partners, threat intelligence enables Defender for Endpoint to identify attacker tools, techniques, and procedures, and generate alerts when they are observed in collected sensor data.

fullname_0: AFN AIT Microsoft Dynamics 365 Guides x.x SaaS

description:
This is a SaaS / PaaS instance of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Guides x.x in use by the organization listed in the solution name.

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Guides is a mixed-reality application for Microsoft HoloLens that helps operators learn during the flow of work by providing holographic instructions when and where they're needed. These instruction cards are visually tethered to the place where the work is done, and can include images, videos, and 3D holographic objects. Operators see exactly what needs to be done, and where, so they can get the job done faster, with fewer errors and greater skill retention. When needed, they can make a call to a remote expert on Microsoft Teams. The remote expert can see what the operator sees on their HoloLens.  Make a call to work collaboratively Dynamics 365 Guides users on HoloLens can collaborate in real time with a remote expert on Microsoft Teams (desktop or mobile). By starting a call from a guide, an operator can share their HoloLens video feed, including holographic guide content, with the remote expert. Call participants can collaborate seamlessly, share expert knowledge, and solve problems faster by sharing first-person views, drawing directly in the HoloLens user's field of view, and bringing critical information into view while in the flow of work. For example, a first-line worker can call an expert if something goes wrong and get advice on how to move forward in a timely manner instead of waiting for support. Or an author might prompt a first-line worker to call a remote expert at a specific step in a guide, or ask a first-line worker to do a remote inspection as a product is being built, which will save time while ensuring high quality.  No coding skills required to create mixed-reality guides With Dynamics 365 Guides, you don't need specialized 3D or programming skills. Start with the PC authoring app to create a guide made up of step-by-step instructions, images, videos, and 3D holograms. After you create the guide on a PC, use the HoloLens app to connect the instruction cards and holograms to the physical workspace by picking them up and moving them to the correct location.

Snowflake Data Warehouse Platform is a cloud-based data warehouse service that allows users to store, analyze, and report on large volumes of data, offering scalability and flexibility by separating storage and compute layers, enabling independent scaling based on needs, all while providing a user-friendly interface with standard SQL querying capabilities; essentially, it's a fully managed platform for data warehousing in the cloud with high performance and concurrency, eliminating the need for on-premise hardware management

Key points about Snowflake:
- Cloud-native: Runs on major cloud providers like AWS, Azure, and GCP, eliminating the need for managing physical infrastructure. 
- Separated storage and compute: Allows for independent scaling of data storage and processing power based on usage. 
- SQL interface: Uses standard SQL for querying data, making it accessible to a wide range of users. 
- Scalability: Can easily scale up or down to handle fluctuating data volumes and processing needs. 
- Data sharing capabilities: Enables secure data sharing between different organizations and users. 
- Multi-cloud support: Can be deployed across multiple cloud providers.

Okta provides a single solution for identity as a service. Okta runs in the cloud, on a secure, reliable, extensively audited platform, which integrates deeply with on-premises applications, directories, and identity management systems. Use context about the user, device, app, network, and intent to inform the identity journey of any user, adapting that access experience accordingly. The Okta Identity Engine is made up of a sequence of individual Steps that can handle the entire user journey from registration to authentication to authorization. * Workflows is now available for any identity use case. name: Surveillance Broadcast Services Monitor
description:
The Surveillance Broadcast Services Monitor (SBSM) is part of the ongoing Next Generation Air Transportation System (NextGen) capital investment program, Surveillance Broadcast Services (SBS). The SBSM is an independent monitor of the status of the SBS System (SBSS), continuously providing monitoring, oversight, and analysis as an independent assessment of the performance of the contracted SBS Service Provider, hereafter referred to as the Service Provider. SBSM monitors status for all equipment and services provided to the FAA by the contracted SBS Service Provider under the SBS contract.  
SBSM ingests message data from the Service Provider and determines the quality and service availability of each of the SBSS services within each defined service volume using the data provided at the service delivery point (SDP). 
SBSM provides enterprise customers and stakeholders a portfolio of independent assessment product services includes online analysis of metrics in digital and hardcopy reports for service usability, real-time situation awareness tools such as digital displays of alarm and alert status of the equipment by operating service volume, target track displays, on-line client analysis tools plus off-line [stand-alone] client investigative and event reconstruction data analysis tools.
SBSM product services are critical decision aids for National Air Space (NAS) coordination functions that meet customer target levels of efficiency, safety and security, and coordinate Tech Ops technical support resource priorities supporting Air Traffic Organization (ATO) operations, En Route and Oceanic Services, Terminal Services and Technical Operations.
The Surveillance Broadcast Services Monitor (SBSM) is a stand-alone application hosting two tools: the ADS-B Service Assurance System (ASAS), which monitors and analyzes SBSS data for jamming, spoofing, or congestion in FAA RF spectrums, and SBS-Proxy, which delivers SBS surveillance data to the FAA’s Enterprise Data Platform (EDP).

Salesforce Agentforce is a platform that enables the creation and deployment of autonomous AI agents to augment human workers and automate tasks across various business functions. These AI agents can handle a wide range of tasks, from customer service and sales to marketing and commerce, operating independently with minimal human intervention.

Core Functionality:
Autonomous AI Agents:
Agentforce allows users to build and deploy AI agents that can operate independently, handling tasks like resolving customer issues, qualifying leads, and even assisting with sales calls. 
Integration with Salesforce:
Agentforce is built on the Salesforce platform and integrates seamlessly with existing Salesforce workflows, data, and apps. 
Customizable Agents:
Users can leverage prebuilt agents or create their own custom agents using familiar Salesforce tools like Flows, Prompt Templates, Apex, and Data Cloud. 
Data-Driven Decisions:
Agentforce agents are grounded in the business's data, particularly when integrated with Data Cloud, ensuring more reliable and contextually relevant responses. 
Enhanced Security:
Agentforce incorporates the Einstein Trust Layer for data protection and customizable guardrails to ensure responsible and secure AI agent interactions. 
How Agentforce Works
Agents need three things to get work done: data, reasoning, and actions. With Agentforce, agents can connect to any data source and use it in real time to plan, reason, and evaluate. And Agentforce agents can leverage any workflow, automation, or API to complete tasks.

Foundry is an operations platform that brings together data, analytics, and operational teams. Designed for both technical and non-technical users, Foundry enables diverse teams to work together on an organization's hardest problems.  Foundry consists of hundreds of distinct services that cover a wide range of functionality. Together, these services combine to form a modular, end-to-end operations platform with minimal configuration. It is helpful to think of Foundry's services in the following categories, which you can explore below:  - Data integration -- Foundry provides an extensible, multimodal data connection framework that connects to enterprise data systems out-of-the-box; an auto-scaling, Kubernetes-based build system for data that works across batch and streaming pipelines; integrated pipeline scheduling and orchestration; native health checks for all data flows; and comprehensive security functionality that spans role-, classification, and purpose-based access controls.  - Model integration -- Foundry offers an integrated, end-to-end environment for model development (e.g., in Python and R); flexible integration of external models built using industry-standard toolsets; governed paths to production for all developed or integrated models; and a “mission control” for continuous evaluation of deployed models.  - The Ontology -- The Ontology assimilates data and models into a comprehensive semantic model of the organization. Capabilities include structured mechanisms for capturing data from end users back into the semantic foundation; out-of-the-box applications for exploring the ontology in structured, unstructured, geospatial, temporal, simulated, and other paradigms; and rich APIs for leveraging the Ontology as an “operational bus” throughout all parts of the enterprise.  - Application frameworks -- Foundry application frameworks evolve analytics into operational workflows that enable user action, alerting, and other frontline functions. Capabilities include low-code and no-code application building

Figma design is a digital artifact created using Figma, a collaborative, cloud-based design tool used to create and prototype user interfaces (UIs) for websites, apps, and other digital products. Figma designs can range from simple wireframes to highly interactive, realistic prototypes, and they facilitate real-time, multiplayer collaboration with built-in feedback and version control features.  Figma Design is for people to create, share, and test designs for websites, mobile apps, and other digital products and experiences. It is a popular tool for designers, product managers, writers and developers and helps anyone involved in the design process contribute, give feedback, and make better decisions, faster. Design files are powerful, collaborative environments where you turn your ideas into responsive and interactive designs. They're useful for creating and maintaining artifacts and assets, where detail and precision are of the utmost importance.
Key Aspects of a Figma Design
- Collaborative Platform: Figma allows multiple users to work on the same design file simultaneously, making it an excellent tool for teams to share ideas and gather feedback in real-time. 
- Wireframes and Mockups: Users can create low-fidelity wireframes to plan layouts and structure, then progress to high-fidelity mockups that define the visual appearance and user experience. 
- Interactive Prototypes: Designs can be transformed into interactive prototypes that simulate user flows and functionality, enabling early user testing before development. 
- Design Systems: Figma supports the creation of design systems, which are libraries of reusable components (like buttons and icons) and styles (like colors and typography) to ensure consistency across a product. 
- Asset Handoff: Designs can be easily shared with developers, who can inspect elements and export assets, often with automatically generated code snippets (like CSS), to aid in the development process.

The purpose of seeking out existing capabilities in Microsoft is to improve efficiency and productivity of the AAP-100 team.  The automated dashboard would eliminate the pain-staking manual process of entering data repetitively in various spreadsheets and reduce the possibility of mistakes in overriding data in a manual excel spreadsheet.
